ai_summary.key_headline: High-Stakes Group F Opener: Dutch Attacking Might Meets Japan's Defensive Wall

netherlands: Jurrien Timber (groin injury - ruled out of tournament)
Bart Verbruggen (hip injury - doubtful for opener)
japan: Wataru Endo (foot injury - pulled from tournament squad)

netherlands.philosophy: High possession, technical build-up, using Cody Gakpo and Donyell Malen to widen the pitch.

japan.philosophy: High discipline, rapid counter-pressing, defensive transitions, and direct counters.

tactical_insights: The Netherlands enters as favorites but carries defensive concerns, having failed to keep a clean sheet in their last 4 warm-up matches.
Japan is in scintillating form with a 6-match winning streak, keeping 5 consecutive clean sheets.
The loss of Wataru Endo is a major blow to Japan's midfield stability, which the Netherlands will aim to exploit through Memphis Depay dropping deep.
Japan will rely on quick transitions, targeting the space behind Dutch full-backs who push high in Koeman's system.
